roles.title: Developer
roles.summary: Help build and improve our Roblox experiences across gameplay, systems, interfaces, and live updates.
responsibilities: Build and maintain player-facing features and internal systems
Turn ideas and prototypes into reliable, production-ready work
Debug and optimize experiences across devices
Collaborate with the rest of the team to ship updates
requirements: Experience in a development discipline relevant to Roblox games
A portfolio featuring strong development work
Comfort working independently on a remote team

roles.title: Growth Marketer
roles.summary: Plan and run creative growth campaigns that turn game launches and updates into lasting player communities.
responsibilities: Build launch and update marketing plans across social channels
Test creative, audiences, and messaging to improve acquisition
Track campaign performance and translate results into action
Coordinate with creators, developers, and community partners
requirements: Experience marketing games, entertainment, or creator-led products
Strong grasp of Roblox and short-form content culture
Comfort with analytics, experimentation, and reporting

roles.title: Content Creator
roles.summary: Create high-energy short-form content that makes players stop scrolling and start playing.
responsibilities: Concept, capture, edit, and publish short-form game content
Turn updates, trends, and community moments into strong creative
Maintain a consistent posting rhythm and brand voice
Review performance and iterate on hooks, formats, and pacing
requirements: A portfolio of engaging TikTok, Shorts, or Reels content
Fast, confident video editing and storytelling skills
Deep familiarity with Roblox audiences and trends
Reliable turnaround and attention to detail
